name: slopify
description: Outcome-driven engineering and research: shape turns ideas into proposals or specs with observable acceptance; explicitly invoked deliver implements or repairs a change through a verified PR, with fresh QA or auditor validation; the research workflow investigates new sources and persists cited evidence and synthesis in the project library; ask answers from that library without internet requests or writes; lint checks and repairs it; bootstrap sets up the board and forge declarations and the library once, with optional Obsidian settings. Agents: coder, writer (production), qa, auditor (fresh report-only validators), library-researcher, library-reader, library-scribe (library production), library-clerk (fresh report-only library validator).
